issues.description: The solution for Aufgabe 04 aliases the column regierungsbezirk as District (SELECT regierungsbezirk AS District ...), which contradicts the explicit instruction in the problem statement not to rename columns with AS unless requested. This can cause automated checks or students' queries to fail because the expected column name is regierungsbezirk and the solution introduces an unexpected column name.
issues.suggestedFix: Remove the alias and select the column using its original name (e.g. SELECT regierungsbezirk, SUM(einwohner_w), SUM(einwohner_m) ...) so the output column names match the problem requirements and automated checks.

issues.description: The solution (aufgabe04.sql) introduces an English column alias 'District' for the column regierungsbezirk (SELECT regierungsbezirk AS District). The problem statement and task language use the German identifier 'Regierungsbezirk' and explicitly instruct students not to rename columns with AS unless asked. This creates an avoidable naming mismatch and conflicts with the stated instruction, increasing cognitive load and risking confusion about the expected column name.
issues.suggestedFix: Remove the alias 'AS District' from the solution so the query returns the original column name (regierungsbezirk). If an alias is necessary, use the German name (e.g., AS regierungsbezirk) to match the problem wording and follow the instruction not to rename columns unless requested.
